text: Ambulance services respond to heart attacks, severe injuries, unconscious persons, and life-threatening medical emergencies.
Emergency medical teams provide rapid assistance for accidents, allergic reactions, and critical illnesses requiring immediate care.
Mumbai Fire Brigade handles house fires, industrial fires, gas leaks, explosions, and other fire-related emergencies.
Firefighters respond to chemical spills, fire outbreaks in residential or commercial buildings, and rescue operations during fire emergencies.
Mumbai Police maintains law enforcement, prevents crimes, and responds to robbery, assault, or other criminal activities.
Police emergency units handle domestic violence, theft, and public safety threats across the city.
Traffic Police manages road safety, responds to vehicle collisions, pedestrian accidents, and traffic rule violations.
Traffic control units attend to accidents, road hazards, and coordinate emergency response for injured people on roads.
Disaster Management Authority coordinates responses to floods, cyclones, earthquakes, landslides, and other environmental hazards.
Emergency management teams handle evacuations, relief operations, and public safety during natural disasters or severe weather events.
